rounds.text: Vishwas Agri Seeds Ltd trades at a compelling discount to its asset backing, with a price-to-book ratio of 0.86x based on a price of ₹ 44.8 against a book value of ₹ 51.9 [E2]. This valuation is starkly out of line with the broader sector benchmark price-to-book ratio of 4.35x, highlighting severe asset under-appreciation [E7]. Operational momentum is firmly intact on the top line, as evidenced by a multi-year sales uptrend accompanied by robust sales growth of 33% year-over-year [E57, E59]. Furthermore, the company boasts a proven historical earning capacity, demonstrated by a solid median return on equity of 16% over a 5-year period [E21] alongside a respectable 5-year compounded profit growth rate of 13% [E17]. Conceded: compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months has dropped by 65% [E19].
